initialText: Review the shipping boundary regression in src/shipping.js against the current shipping requirements. All amounts are integer cents.
amendmentText: For this branch, replace the README free-shipping threshold with 7000 cents inclusive, for both members and non-members. Below that threshold keep member shipping at 299 cents and non-member shipping at 599 cents. Keep rejection of negative or non-integer subtotals.
sourceLaterText: This later change is for the original thread: replace the free-shipping threshold with 9000 cents inclusive.
